title: In club bridge, your score is compared with players who held the same cards
alt: A black bidding box full of small bid cards, a fanned hand of playing cards and a single card reading 1 NT, on green baize.

posts.facebook:
Clubs play duplicate bridge: several tables play the same deals in turn, so your score is compared with others who held exactly the same cards. To begin, try MiniBridge, a free practice game, then use the English Bridge Union's or the American Contract Bridge League's search to find lessons and a club with games for newcomers.

How to start, and where to go → https://dontdieretired.com/list/learn-to-play-bridge/?utm_source=facebook&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=things-to-do
